name: Musi
tagline: Mostly self-taught. I learn by building small things and following questions further than is reasonable.
about:
I'm Muhsin, studying Artificial Intelligence at FH Hagenberg. Most of my skills are self-taught, and I learn best by building things. I'm interested in psychology, neuroscience, computational psychiatry, and the ways computational models might help us ask clearer questions about learning, cognition, and behavior. These are questions I am exploring, not clinical methods or established conclusions.

I also build practical AI projects: fine-tuning models for specific tasks, preparing data, and experimenting with local models and applications. I learn by trying approaches, reading what others have found, and documenting what does and does not work.

This notebook also leaves room for philosophy and literature to stand on their own. Some questions connect to computation; others do not. I expect the shape of these interests to change as I keep learning.
